_comment: Read by scripts/instance-templates.py. `optional`: instance files the core reads that need no template, each with the reason (the reader falls back to built-ins, the file is written by a tool, ...). `unclassified`: the gaps measured when the check was built (2026-10-30, 19 names) — a ratchet: a name may only leave this list (a template in templates/rules-instance/ or an optional reason here), never join it.
